purpose: An ignored nullsafe owning CURRENT retires the receiver despite a cached Token destructor throwing a supplied Exception. A fresh destructor probe sees only destructor/caller frames; original identity/trace/Previous and both weak deaths survive to catch.

<?php
class Token110T {
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakGenerator, $weakToken, $stop;
        echo 'DTOR|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakToken->get() === $this, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('probe110T'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Token110T', '|', $trace[0]['type'] === '->', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run110T', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe);
        throw $stop;
    }
}
function stream110T() {
    global $weakToken;
    try { $token = new Token110T(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); yield $token; }
    finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
}
function make110T() { global $weakGenerator; $generator = stream110T(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator); return $generator; }
function run110T() { echo 'RUN|'; make110T()?->current(); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
$stop = new Exception('stop110T');
echo 'CALL|';
try { run110T(); echo 'BAD-CALLER|'; }
catch (Throwable $caught) {
    $trace = $caught->getTrace();
    echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', !isset($trace[0]), '|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
}
echo 'DONE|';
